title: lessingianthus grandiflorus
intro: Lessingianthus grandiflorus, commonly known as the "Brazilian plume-back", is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is a shrubby herb with clusters of small, white or pink flowers, known for its potential health benefits and therapeutic properties. The plant is rich in flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other bioactive constituents that have been reported to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and anti-infective properties. The bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are believed to be responsible for the plant's health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
